messages:
maya: Kicking off a config-only rollout for routing + batching changes. Targeting eu-west first during the 23:00-01:00 UTC change window. Canary cadence: 5% cohorts staggered 15m.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled config deploy: id cfg-2026-03-21-7055551111, target=eu-west, canary=5%, stagger=15m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cfg-rollout

sven: FYI — per-tenant QPS hard cap lowered 1000 -> 800. batching window param bumped 8ms -> 12ms. Expect lower head-of-line pressure, slightly higher throughput per-token.

eli: Quick question — does the change touch KV cache eviction semantics? we saw issues before when batch windows changed.

zoe: KV cache not modified in this patch. main risk is increased coalescing for seq_len>1024 which can push memory pressure on some hosts. watch kv_hit_rate and mem_used.

maya: Canary cohorts: internal-prod -> alpha-customers -> random-5pct. Starting internal-prod at 23:05 UTC.

amanda: I'll own monitoring handoff. Alerts: p95 > 600ms OR error_rate > 0.5% triggers manual rollback. Also watch fallback_count to compat-small variant.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary started for cohort internal-prod @7055551211

sven: Added trace tag `cfg_batch_2026_03` for affected requests so we can filter traces quickly.

eli: If tail latency spikes, rollback options? revert batching param or switch routing to compat-small model variant?

maya: Rollback plan: 1) toggle to previous batching profile via "/config rollback cfg-2026-batch-2026-03" (fast). 2) If issues persist, flip routing to compat-small variant for region. Full runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cfg-rollback

amanda: Also enabling auto-fallthrough: if model latency > 1000ms for 3 consecutive minutes, route to regional fallback with no-batching change (costlier but safe).

zoe: Add a short-lived feature flag `batching_experiment_v2` so we can A/B metric comparisons. Will tag metrics exporter.

maya: Post-canary checklist: validate p50/p95 & errors for 30m, ensure KV memory stable, confirm cost delta <5%.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary progressed to 50% cohorts at 7055551311 — no alerts reported.

sven: Seeing ~3% uptick in per-token cost on embeddings route. within threshold.

eli: If stable, proposal: push to NA region after 90m. objections?

amanda: no objections. I'll prep announcement + update runbook with explicit thresholds and rollback commands.

maya: Proceeding with NA rollout at 7055551811 unless someone raises a blocker.

zoe: no blockers from infra side. I'll run long-tail synthetic tests during NA rollout.

sven: Note for release notes: "config-only: tightened per-tenant QPS limits, increased batching window, routing policy tweak to favor fallback variants under high latency."

maya: Thanks everyone — will close thread when NA is stable. :thumbsup:
